content: Analyze and identify the root cause of why non-system dictionaries aren't displaying data despite showing high pagination counts
Fix the data loading logic in DictionaryTabs component to properly load data for non-system dictionary types
Fix the read-only status logic - ensure only 'system' and 'system-synonym' dictionaries show as read-only
Fix pagination logic to use the actual filtered data count instead of showing inflated page numbers
Fix search functionality to work properly with all dictionary types
Update the initial data loading logic in the main page to load actual data for the default 'system' tab
